R3_add: pilot-only log1p nearest Euclidean occupied-source distance
reference.R2_generic_context_topology: actual response-independent graph only; held fixed for R3 and all candidate-C models

C_actual_add: pilot-only log1p nearest actual-graph occupied-source path distance
candidate_models.C_null_add: the same two graph-path source features recomputed independently on each frozen matched null adjacency

focal_training_exclusion.rule: for a pilot training row, exclude the focal pilot island from occupancy counts and occupied-source set
focal_training_exclusion.confirmatory_rule: for a confirmatory prediction row, use all six pilot islands and no confirmatory occurrence value

empty_source_semantics.why_needed: species with one pilot presence have one positive pilot training row whose focal-excluded occupied-source set is empty
empty_source_semantics.rule_source: inherit the established global-mammal ultrarare convention rather than tune to bird outcomes
empty_source_semantics.graph_nearest_empty_km: (19-1) * maximum ACTUAL graph edge length + frozen kernel scale
empty_source_semantics.reason_same_null_sentinel: rows with no source must not acquire artificial actual-vs-null topology differences

standardization.base_features: population mean/SD over all frozen 19 islands
standardization.R3_source_features: mean/SD over all 108 pilot island x fixed-species training rows
standardization.each_C_graph_features: mean/SD over the same 108 training rows separately for actual and each frozen null topology

prediction_surface.row_order: frozen confirmatory block order, island ascending within block, fixed eligible-species order

primary_scoring_inherited.P1: equal-block mean among realized presences of within-block S-normalized weighted [logloss(C_actual)-logloss(R3)]
primary_scoring_inherited.P2: equal-block mean among realized presences of within-block S-normalized weighted [logloss(C_actual)-mean logloss(C_null_01..20)]
primary_scoring_inherited.support_requires: P1 and P2 each have point estimate < 0 and 95% spatial-block bootstrap upper bound < 0

success_ceiling.next_action: exact-replay and commit prediction surface/model receipt; only then issue separate one-shot confirmatory bird response authorization
